These bills take valuable steps to expand the use of AI, develop a skilled AI workforce, and improve our tools for AI research and development. 

They don’t impose regulations and burdensome requirements. Instead, they’re designed to help American businesses and workers and to keep us at the cutting edge of global competition.

deepseek.reason: The statement supports AI bills and global competitiveness but does not mention China or a China race priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Only generic global competition is mentioned, not competition with China.

china_race_dynamics.text: Having capable, trained STEM workers at all points of the chain in the AI workforce is going to be crucial if we are to compete with China.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says trained AI STEM workers are crucial to compete with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly ties AI workforce development to competing with China.
